OpenWarp advice · 1 finding

KV cache fragmentation · qwen2.5:14b                            confidence: high
  Most of the reserved KV cache holds no tokens, wasting VRAM.

  Evidence
    Context       32,768 tokens
    Per token     192 KiB         f16 K and V, 48 layers × 8 KV heads
    KV reserved   6,144 MiB       above the 1,024 MiB threshold
    Last request  158 tokens      0.5% of the context
  Likely cause    Context window far larger than the last request

  Fix (pick one)
    1. PagedAttention (vLLM)   pip install vllm
                               vllm serve HF_MODEL
                               (in a venv; HF_MODEL is the Hugging Face repo of
                               qwen2.5:14b)
    2. Smaller context         /set parameter num_ctx 2048   (inside ollama run)

  Why
    Ollama reserves the KV cache for the full context window when the model
    loads, so VRAM held for tokens a request never reaches is wasted.
    PagedAttention allocates the cache in small blocks as tokens arrive, so only
    the last block of a request is partly empty.

  Source  Kwon et al., "Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention," SOSP 2023, arXiv:2309.06180

Advice only. OpenWarp did not change any settings.
